scope: Installation continues when Rounded Corners is installed and enabled but KWin cannot confirm activation in the current session.

checks.command: python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_rounded_corners_step.py (34 passed, one opt-in native SDK build skipped). Three previously fatal live activation cases were reproduced against v0.84.17.

On a disposable KDE neon 6.8.1 Wayland guest with Golden Gate defaults, run installer_backend.py install --wizard-options with Rounded Corners selected. Filter only its ID from the loadedEffects reply on the first installation. Confirm the login warning and completion. Reinstall with the real D-Bus response and confirm the effect loads.

coverage_limits: The VM exercised the shared installer under Golden Gate defaults. The reporter’s compositor state on Plasma 6.8.3 is unknown. A separate Tahoe desktop and X11 were not exercised. No native effect or shader changed.
